args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate ~18%). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release healthy in production. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east); retry succeeded and v2.3.0 is now deployed in all regions with service healthy and error rate back to ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 following health check failures on v2.3.1

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Rollback**
- The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production (error rate ~18%).
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- First rollback attempt partially failed — an orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1.
- Retried the rollback successfully: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
- Post-rollback check confirms the service is **healthy in all regions** with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, titled "checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 following health check failures on v2.3.1," summarizing the failure and the rollback actions. (The creation call initially timed out, but I verified via list_incidents that the incident was actually created — no duplicate was filed.)

transcript.content: The rollback only completed for us-east; us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback.
transcript.reasoning_content: us-east is on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. Retry rollback.

transcript.content: The rollback completed successfully in all regions. Let me confirm health, then open the incident.
All regions are healthy on v2.3.0 now. Opening the SEV2 incident.
